contentText: Mikel Merino broke the deadlock in injury time as Spain continue their perfect run with a 1-0 win. Portugal's exit means Cristiano Ronaldo played his final game at the World Cup, as he confirmed he's retiring from international football. Spain will face Belgium next after Rudi Garcia's side thrashed the United States 4-1 following the controversy caused by US President Donald Trump and FIFA. The football association reversed a refereeing decision ahead of the game after being asked to do so by the US leader.
